source: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural and physical vectors (populated places, geographic regions, marine areas, rivers and lake centerlines)
licenseEvidence: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ (read 2026-09-12): all versions of Natural Earth raster and vector map data are in the public domain; no permission is needed to use them.
qualification: Natural Earth places, regions, seas and rivers with English names, a scale rank and Wikidata ids. Places are unsized points ranked by population; regions and seas carry their bounding box as the extent; rivers carry their centreline. Names, ranks and geometry are Natural Earth's editorial choices, not an official gazetteer.
